title: Zoe bento
description: An edge-to-edge bento of 16px-rounded square tiles on a 6-column grid (3 rows on desktop, 2 columns on phones): big and small photos, figure tiles with a large light serif number and a small uppercase caption on navy or sage, and feature tiles with a title over a composite on yellow or cream. Pictures fade in as the grid enters view.
notes: eight fixed slots, in this order: big, small, small, big, big, small, small, wide (the wide one is hidden on phones)
figure numbers use the theme-only --zoe-serif face, falling back to the display face
the fade is a CSS view timeline; without support everything shows at once
name: zoe-bento

props.name: tiles
props.description: up to eight tiles, filling the slots big, small, small, big, big, small, small, wide
